  Pickleball project had been approved by council and awarded to a
  vendor. Construction scheduled for only a couple of weeks for
  completion.

  Vice Chair Rodriguez and Commissioner Tsang stated their interest on returning
  the inflatable haunted maze for future events.

  Youth Commissioner Yassine commented on the schedule conflict with the
  Spooktacular event and the local high school' s homecoming events and stated
  that many high school students benefit from the event for volunteer hours.

  Chair Bartolo requested for future consideration to include a Halloween home
  decoration contest.

6.  New Business

  Public Works Sr. Management Analyst, Lauren Marshall, presented and reviewed
  on the Marchant Park Stormwater design project staff report.

  The project will include the following:
  The Commission input on the types of park amenities to be included on the
  design project for instance, corn hole platforms, game tables, rain gardens or
  sensory playgrounds and activities.
  Underground stormwater treatment and infiltration system for approximately
  77 acres of neighborhood above ground water runoff equivalent to an
  estimate of 2. 8 acre-feet of wet weather flow annually.
  Budget for design estimated at $645, 117. 00 for design contract, contingency
  and engineering consultant services.
  Construction phase funding still pending.
  Concept -site review in attachments.
  Outreach events to gather community feedback.

  Commissioner' s provided the following feedback:
  Commissioner Moon recommended an area with native plants that are
  labeled and a walking path.
  Commissioner Tsang suggested a volleyball court would be most popular
  with the community.
  Chair Bartolo suggested outdoor exercise equipment with shade and
  additional lighting.
  Vice Chair Rodriguez commented to consider security cameras.
  Youth Commissioner Yassine requested confirmation on location of security
  cameras. Mr. Wasserman stated a study would be conducted to review the
  best angles and scope of views.
  Ms. Marshall stated the Lone Hill project is still in design stages and pending funding
  for construction, reviewing different avenues for funding possibilities with grants,
  taxes, county measures, etc.
